filter_rule: Remove any step where any of the 25 SC5_FEATURES is missing, empty, NaN, or non-numeric in the telemetry CSV.
filter_rationale: V2 bridge only writes f_* streaming features when feat_valid=True.
Steps with feat_valid=False (invalid feature steps) have no 25D feature values.
SC5 MLP detector only processes feature-valid steps, so training on invalid steps is incorrect.
Filter is deterministic and label-independent — no Teacher label or model outcome was used.
Filter was applied BEFORE any training run (the trainer failed on first attempt with missing feature error).
